headlines.title: ESET Research discovers vulnerable UEFI shims undermining devices’ Secure Boot

ANIP.summary: ANI Pharmaceuticals reported positive Phase 4 trial results for ILUVIEN (fluocinolone acetonide intravitreal implant) in treating chronic non-infectious uveitis affecting the posterior segment. WRD.summary: WeRide announced progress in international expansion of its L2++ intelligent driving business, with on-road testing and localization validation beginning in Germany, France, Japan and other markets.
